name: Fire or Retire
beta: Climb the corner, then at its top step right and go up to the belay bolts.

name: Flakey Friends
beta: Pull onto the ledge from its left end (the crux), then ascend the face's left portion, keeping away from the line of bolts.
overview: A bouldery entry onto a ledge, then the left portion of the face, kept clear of the bolts.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: west face of the tower: surmount a low ledge at its left end (crux) and climb the face's left flank, avoiding the bolt line

name: Fluff Boy
beta: Take the previous route up to about two-thirds height, then angle up and right into a crack that goes by a fixed pin and a bolt.
overview: Begins up Mad Race, then peels off high on the wall and heads right along a crack. The stone here is of poor quality.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: shares the start of Mad Race, leaving it two-thirds up to angle right

name: Fool's Gold
beta: Ascend a chute, clipping a bolt on the way to a shelf, then continue on twin cracks.
overview: A chute with a single bolt leads to a ledge, above which twin cracks continue. That bolt was added later.

current.area_walk_in: Take the nature trail northeast, crest a rise and pass a marker, then after roughly 100 yards swing left over flat slabs and head southwest into a brushy, boulder-strewn valley. Where it opens (Lost Corridor) bear right into a tighter passage that pinches very narrow; when it widens, the Corridor Face is the wall on your left. A more direct option starts below the Pathetic routes and heads northeast via a rocky passage.
current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: leftmost route of the wall

name: For Peter
beta: Angle leftward and upward onto a horizontal dike, track it to the left, and then a line of bolts climbs directly up the wall.
overview: Slants leftward onto a horizontal dike, follows that dike, then straight-up bolts take over.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: roughly 125 ft beyond the earlier routes

name: Forgotten Galaxy
beta: Climb to the lowest bolt on the neighboring route, then trend up and rightward to a crack that drops from the top.
overview: Begins by following Anti-Gravity Acrobatics to its initial bolt, then trends up and rightward into a crack that comes down from the top.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Forty Days of Rain
beta: Dynamic, reachy face moves lead into a roof crack that crosses several stacked ceilings; the sequences are strenuous and a single large cam must go in under the roof ahead of the lip clip.
overview: A genuine roof crack: a chain of ceilings adds up to one ten-foot roof problem, entered via reachy dynamic face moves. The sequence is strenuous throughout.

current.area_walk_in: Roughly a quarter hour on marked trails from the Bear Gulch day-use area.
current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Fowl Play
beta: Clip the bolt, then step into the patina cracks and follow them upward.
overview: A bolt-protected line that moves into patina-covered cracks, next to Ouef's Up.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)

name: Fresh Combination
beta: Follow the crack as it slants left to the notch, then continue on gentle face, clipping one bolt.
overview: A crack that leans left up into the notch separating two towers, then eases onto a low-angle face.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: around 40 ft beyond the preceding routes

name: Frozen at the Void
beta: Begin beside Prisoner of Inertia, in or by a corner shaped like an open book; two bolts lead to a pillar crest and one more takes you to the summit.
overview: Two bolts reach the summit of a pillar, and one more leads to the crest of the rock.

name: Gait of Power
beta: Boulder by a bolt just beyond the neighboring route to reach a crack that heads right, then returns left to join Squat Rockets.
overview: A bouldery start past a bolt gains a crack that runs rightward before cutting back toward Squat Rockets.

name: Galen's Crack
beta: Large cams in the 3 and 4 sizes protect the crack.
overview: A short crack along the highway's northern edge, ranging from hands to an offwidth that takes fists.

name: Gaston's Groove
beta: Work up a steep groove protected by three bolts.
overview: A steeply tilted groove with bolts for protection, set at the right-hand end of a corridor.

name: Give a Mouse a Cookie
beta: Use opposing cracks to reach a small ledge, then angle up and rightward on the face, clipping bolts, until you join Easy Day.
overview: Faces-off cracks lead to a little ledge, after which bolted face climbing trends up-right to merge with Easy Day.

name: Go Ask Alice
beta: Begin over on the southwest wall's leftmost part, clip a bolt and gain a dike holding a fixed pin; keep climbing to a ledge, then finish on the upper wall, which has three bolts.
overview: Clip a bolt, reach a dike that has a fixed pin, go on to a ledge, then finish up a higher wall using three more bolts.

name: Left Side of Great Roof
beta: Begin from the ledge and follow four bolts beside the roof's left margin, in an airy position.
overview: An exposed, airy bolt-protected line that leaves the ledge and goes up the wall just left of the main roof. It is the only lead on a rock whose other lines are mostly set up on top rope.

current.area_walk_in: Hike westward along Saratoga Gap Trail toward the waterfall, but peel off short of it onto Ridge Trail. This heads northwest, under a mile; Billy Goat Rock appears first, with Goat Rock just beyond, both beside the path.
current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: From the ledge, running up the bolt line to the left of the big roof

name: Lonely Sheepherder
beta: Begin beyond the overhanging base and traverse up and rightward past a bolt, then ascend the chimney in a long first lead of 140 feet with two more bolts, ending on a ledge with belay bolts; a shorter second lead finishes the chimney.
overview: The main chimney up the middle of a north face, climbed in two leads.

current.area_walk_in: About 45 minutes on foot. Most parties go by the western side around Satyr Pinnacle; some routes are reached through the gap between Satyr Pinnacle and Goat Rock, others by dropping northwest toward the northeast end of the rock.
current.location: Centre of the north side: begin to the left of the bulging base, then angle up right into the big chimney

name: Gracias a Dios
beta: Climb a corner that faces right, clipping three bolts, then move right and continue up a crack with a further two bolts until you top out.
overview: Ascends a right-facing corner with three bolts, then shifts right up a crack that has two more bolts.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: 20 ft along from Not A Hogan

name: Grand Cayman
beta: Start in the crack on the north face's right side, then continue directly up, clipping the bolt.
overview: A short, minor line on a small boulder, with a crack leading to a single bolt.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: eastern portion of a 30 ft boulder's northern side

name: Abacus
beta: Start a few feet beyond the two earlier routes, pass through the overhang clipping two bolts and reaching a third beside the thin seam; from there either go straight up for the harder finish, or trend right for the easier one.
overview: Crosses the overhang on a pair of bolts and reaches a third beside the thin seam of its neighbour. From there either continue vertically (5.11d) or veer right (5.11a).

current.area_walk_in: The formation lies a few hundred feet beyond the Stirrup Towers, off to the west. Most of its lines sit on the side facing those towers.
current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: about 6 ft beyond the two preceding routes

name: Hammer and Anvil
beta: Leave the notch, clip the bolt, and move into the crack above.
overview: An old line that leaves the notch between two towers and climbs by way of a bolt, then enters a crack.

current.descent: (no DESCENT section on this route's page)
current.location: out of the gap separating both towers, around 40 ft beyond the upper part of Fresh Combination

name: Handygland
beta: Climb the crack to the arete and carry on up its edge, clipping its two bolts.

name: Headless Horseman
beta: Clip the bolts at the start, then enter the thin left-slanting crack.
overview: A line set up and away from the big cliff, with bolts leading into a thin crack that slants leftward.

current.area_walk_in: A brown wall facing north, streaked dark, with a big corner at its right end. Reach it by about a quarter hour of walking up talus.

name: Steve's Folly
beta: Go up a steep, enclosed waterchute to a ledge, then work a short face with bolts to a second ledge holding a tree and belay there to cut rope drag. Above, take the corner facing right (the original line and the crux, three bolts) or its twin facing left with cams, then scramble easily rightward.
overview: Pleasurable mixed-style climbing on reasonable rock, seldom repeated.

current.area_walk_in: The formation fills the angle where the Moses Spring Trail meets the High Peaks Trail.
current.location: In the steep, enclosed water chute immediately beside the trail on its left.

name: Herman

overview: Steep face climbing on the northeast side of a big boulder, protected by two bolts.
